entries.description: number of tokens to draft for speculative decoding (default: 3) (env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX)
entries.notes: Maps onto mlxcel's draft-token cap (--draft / --draft-max) with the canonical spelling and the LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX binding accepted on both binaries. The default differs: b10621 drafts 3 tokens, mlxcel's MTP / DFlash tuning defaults to 16, so the entry is aliased rather than supported.

entries.description: minimum number of draft tokens to use for speculative decoding (default: 0) (env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_MIN)
entries.notes: MTP / DFlash verify whole draft blocks and have no per-step minimum; the 0 default (no minimum) is inert and accepted, any other value fails startup pointing at --draft-block-size.

entries.description: max. number of draft model layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number, 'auto', or 'all' (default: auto) (env: LLAMA_ARG_N_GPU_LAYERS_DRAFT)
entries.notes: mlxcel keeps every draft layer on the accelerator: auto and all are inert, a numeric partial offload fails startup.

entries.notes: mlxcel verifies draft tokens against the target distribution instead of thresholding draft probabilities; the 0.00 default (greedy, no threshold) is inert, any other value fails startup.

entries.description: comma-separated list of types of speculative decoding to use (default: none) (env: LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_TYPE)
entries.notes: Only the none default is accepted (the inert selector; draft speculation is configured through --model-draft with --draft-kind). Every n-gram mode fails startup with a diagnostic naming the mlxcel alternative, so a speculation subsystem mlxcel does not run can never be silently requested.

entries.description: Maximum number of tokens to draft during speculative decoding
entries.notes: Per-request speculative overrides have no path into mlxcel's server-wide MTP / DFlash configuration; any present key under the declared `speculative` object is rejected with a 400 naming the server flags, and an empty object is accepted as inert (it sets nothing upstream either).
